math_qualification: Existing compiler-builtins exports, bounded ABI/value probes only, no added errno or long-double guarantee. Existing libm numerical suite retained.
constants: BUFSIZ=8192 (recommended application block size, not buffering)
ownership: fdopen transfers fd ownership only on success
fdopen allocates before append flag mutation
ungetc slot protected by existing stream lock
getenv returns immutable startup storage; no new allocation/lifetime
qsort allocates nothing; comparator receives original element addresses
memory formatting writes directly to caller destination; no whole-output temporary
standards_limits: all existing native signal/lifetime/retirement qualifications unchanged
no dynamic loader or Linux runtime libraries introduced

prioritization.selection: Demonstrated missing declarations; verified owning-layer support before implementation
prioritization.ABI_risk: Public prototypes match native SysV LP64; existing syscall/wire ABIs preserved
prioritization.testability: Native guest cases and independent host oracle for decimal formatting
